evidence.note: OptiRAG-Rec pairs a lightweight GCN-based retriever (replacing an expensive LLM-embedding retriever) with a multi-head early-exit mechanism -- separately fine-tuned language heads at intermediate layers that terminate inference once cross-layer prediction stability crosses a threshold -- for RAG-enhanced LLM click-through-rate recommendation, cutting retrieval time up to 500x and inference overhead while improving AUC over full-shot and few-shot baselines.
evidence.title: The Efficiency vs. Accuracy Trade-off: Optimizing RAG-Enhanced LLM Recommender Systems Using Multi-Head Early Exit
